questions.q: What is the full meaning of NAFDAC in Nigeria?
options: National Association for Food and Drug Administration Control
National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control
Nigerian Agency for Food and Drugs Allocation Centre
National Authority for Food and Drug Awareness Council
questions.explain: NAFDAC stands for National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control.

questions.q: Which agency in Nigeria is primarily responsible for fighting drug trafficking and abuse?
questions.explain: NDLEA (National Drug Law Enforcement Agency) is charged with eliminating the growing, processing, manufacturing, selling, exporting, and trafficking of hard drugs.
questions.subject: Physical & Health Education

options: Taking drugs according to doctor's prescription
Using drugs without medical justification or overdose
questions.explain: Drug abuse involves the excessive, maladaptive, or non-medical use of drugs.

questions.q: Which of the following is considered a 'gateway drug'?
questions.explain: Alcohol and tobacco are often considered gateway drugs because their use can lead to the use of harder drugs.
questions.subject: Physical & Health Education

questions.q: A state where a person needs a drug to function normally is called ________.
questions.explain: Addiction or dependence is a condition where the body relies on the drug to function.
questions.subject: Physical & Health Education

questions.q: Which of these is a social consequence of drug abuse?
questions.explain: Increased crime rate is a social effect affecting the community, while the others are physiological effects.
questions.subject: Physical & Health Education

questions.explain: Alcohol slows down vital functions, classifying it as a central nervous system depressant.
questions.subject: Physical & Health Education

questions.q: Substances that cause a person to see or hear things that are not real are called ________.
questions.subject: Physical & Health Education

questions.q: One of the physical effects of smoking Indian Hemp (Marijuana) is ________.
questions.explain: Red eyes are a common immediate physical sign of marijuana use.
questions.subject: Physical & Health Education

questions.q: Medicines that are bought without a doctor's prescription are called ________ drugs.
questions.explain: Over-the-Counter (OTC) drugs are safe for self-medication when used as directed and do not require a prescription.
questions.subject: Physical & Health Education

questions.q: The misuse of anabolic steroids is common in sports to ________.
questions.explain: Athletes may abuse steroids to unnaturally build muscle and strength.
questions.subject: Physical & Health Education

questions.q: What represents the 'E' in the acronym NDLEA?
questions.explain: NDLEA stands for National Drug Law **Enforcement** Agency.
